TALLYFORGE SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT

Subscription Fee: $750 per month, invoiced annually in advance.

At the end of the Initial Term and of each Renewal Term, this Agreement will automatically renew for a further Renewal Term of 12 months unless Customer gives Vendor written notice of cancellation at least 60 days before the renewal date, and the fee for each Renewal Term is $9,000, payable in advance.

Customer will defend, indemnify and hold harmless Vendor and its officers, employees and affiliates from and against any and all claims, losses, damages, fines, costs and expenses, including reasonable attorneys' fees, arising out of or relating to Customer Materials or Customer's use of the Service.

Vendor may amend these Terms and Conditions at any time in its sole discretion, and each amendment takes effect when Vendor posts it in the Service.

If Customer terminates this Agreement before the end of the Initial Term for any reason other than Vendor's uncured material breach, Customer will pay Vendor an early termination fee of $2,250.

This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Oregon, and the exclusive venue for any proceeding that is not subject to arbitration is the state and federal courts located in Multnomah County, Oregon.
